title: Despa House, 538  Lockerbie Street, Indianapolis, Marion County, IN
notes: Significance: This simple three-bay brick cottage was erected about 1862 and is typical of residences built for the working class.  It has served as a school and day care center for a time, but has been restored and is now a private residence.
